provenance.construction: Multi-band dense-packed surface code (generalization of the two-band packing of arXiv:2511.06758, builder research/multiband_surface.py build): square surface-code patches of size d=11 in 5 horizontal bands at pitch 16, 2 patches per even band and 1 per odd band, odd bands half-pitch staggered. Parameters (d, rows, m, pitch)=(11,5,2,16), at measured pitch floor 2*floor(3d/4)=16. n=848, k=8 by exact GF(2) rank, max check weight 4, one connected component.
